name: fractal-svelte
description: Svelte 5 / SvelteKit build agent with an on-disk CLI tool surface.

interface.shortDescription: Routed Svelte 5 / SvelteKit agent with a CLI tool surface
interface.longDescription: One agent, one contract. A zero-dependency CLI (bin/fa.mjs) routes each task to the exact skills to load, serves component recipes and the project's real design tokens, and writes three-layer verification receipts. Progressive disclosure by default: 22 skills on disk, 2-3 loaded per task.
defaultPrompt: fa route "add an accordion to the docs page"
Route this task, load only the skills it names, then build and verify.
Run fa doctor and fix any armory integrity problems.
